rules.description: Applicant must be a UK national, Irish citizen, or have settled/pre-settled status
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be a UK national, Irish citizen, or have eligible residency status to apply for student finance

rules.description: Applicant must have lived in the UK, Channel Islands or Isle of Man for 3 years before course start (if home is in England)
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have been continuously living in the UK, Channel Islands or Isle of Man for 3 years before the first day of your first academic year

rules.description: Course must be at a qualifying UK university or college
rules.reason_if_failed: Your university or college must offer a qualifying course for student finance

rules.description: Course must be a qualifying higher education course
rules.reason_if_failed: Your course type does not qualify for student finance. Check with your institution.

rules.description: Applicant must be studying first higher education qualification or meet limited funding criteria
rules.reason_if_failed: You've already completed a higher education course. You may only be eligible for limited funding in certain circumstances.

rules.description: Part-time course must have at least 25% course intensity
rules.reason_if_failed: Your part-time course must have a course intensity of at least 25% to qualify for student finance

rules.description: Applicants aged 60+ on first day of course can only get limited Maintenance Loan if studying full-time
rules.reason_if_failed: If you're 60 or over, you may get limited funding for Maintenance Loans. Check the calculator for details.

rules.description: Applicant must not be doing a degree apprenticeship
rules.reason_if_failed: You are not eligible for student finance if you're doing a degree apprenticeship. Speak to your employer about funding.

explanation_template: Student finance eligibility: {outcome}. Tuition Fee Loan: {tuition_eligible}. Maintenance Loan: {maintenance_eligible}.

edge_cases.description: Student is under 25 and has no contact with parents
edge_cases.action: Route to estranged student pathway via UCAS. Household income not required. Maximum maintenance loan available.

edge_cases.description: Student spent 13+ weeks in care before age 16
edge_cases.action: Route to care leaver pathway via UCAS. Household income not used for Maintenance Loan calculation. Maximum amount available.

edge_cases.description: Student previously stopped studies or changed course
edge_cases.action: Assess remaining funding entitlement based on years previously funded. May require evidence if stopped for personal reasons.

edge_cases.description: Student has a degree but applying for priority STEM or healthcare subject
edge_cases.action: Limited funding may be available. Check specific subject eligibility and calculate remaining entitlement.

edge_cases.description: Disabled student unable to attend course in person
edge_cases.action: Maintenance Loan available for distance learning students with disabilities. Route to DSA assessment.

edge_cases.description: Someone else is applying on behalf of the student using Power of Attorney
edge_cases.action: Verify Power of Attorney documentation. Separate consent and identity verification required for agent.

edge_cases.description: Student has a medical condition that may affect their ability to complete the course
edge_cases.action: Route to specialist assessment. May require medical evidence. Consider Disabled Students' Allowance application.

edge_cases.description: Student's home is in Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland, or Crown Dependencies
edge_cases.action: Handoff to appropriate jurisdiction student finance body. This service is for England residents only.
